messages:
alex: Heads up — tenant metadata migration needs to run tonight. Originally planned 02:00 UTC but resharding may overlap. It's an ADD COLUMN + background fill. Thinking of nudging the quiet slot to 01:30 and capping the window to 15m. Thoughts?

maya: I prefer 01:30 and a hard 15m cap. If resharding overlaps we abort early.

suresh: Rollback criteria set: any processing queue backlog > 10k rows OR p99 write latency > 300ms sustained for > 5m => abort and pin service versions. Also if backfill progress < 500 rows/s after first 10m then abort.

alex: Will pin the migration task to service version v2.14.3 and keep flag off by default. jen can you add a release-note blurb?

deploy-bot: Scheduled migration task 'tenant_meta_add_idx' (id: 3259876543) will start at 2026-03-23T01:30:00Z. Plan: canary on 2 tenants, then fanout in batches of 5. Operators: @maya @suresh.

jen: Adding release note: "Tenant metadata: add account_tier column + background index; backfill only, no read-change." Linking rollback playbook: https://go/docs/migrations/tenant-meta-rollback

maya: Ops checklist snippet — if abort, do: `feature.tenant_meta_migration=false` to stop fans, then stop backfill workers. If DB sessions need relief: `psql -c "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ILIKE '%tenant_meta%'"`

suresh: Confirming migration SQL is online-safe: `ALTER TABLE tenant_meta ADD COLUMN account_tier text;` then `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_tenant_account_tier ON tenant_meta (account_tier);` Backfill is an app worker process writing rows; no exclusive locks expected.

alex: Monitoring plan: watch p99 writes, queue lengths, and backfill rate. Canary failure rules: deploy-bot reports 1 failed canary => manual rollback. If backfill ETA > 2h (based on remaining rows / rate) => abort and escalate.

deploy-bot: Canary started on tenant t-101 at 2026-03-23T01:30:25Z. Logs: `canary: ok`

maya: Canary looks clean from infra side. Starting batch fanout (5 tenants per wave). -watching p99 and queue meters-

deploy-bot: Fanout wave 1/4 initiated. ETA per wave ~8m. Status: progressing.

alex: Noted a brief p99 spike to 380ms around 3259876570 (01:31:10). I checked with resharding team — they had a drain in parallel that caused transient IO pressure. If spike persists for 5m we abort.

maya: Agreed. If we need to stop mid-fanout, we'll flip the feature flag and stop workers. Index creation is concurrent so we won't roll back DDL, just halt application writes and resume later.

jen: Release notes posted to #release-notes and I've added the post-deploy checklist to the doc. Also tagged support with a heads-up.

deploy-bot: Fanout wave 4/4 complete. Migration task 3259876543 finished for 20/20 tenants at 2026-03-23T01:37:12Z. Summary: no canary failures, no abort triggered.

alex: Thanks everyone — monitoring for 30m and closing the window unless we see regressions. If anything creeps up open the rollback thread and we follow the playbook.
